method: Eligibility decisions were made before solver calls; source discussions and references are public. These are selected examples rather than an exhaustive audit.

exclusions.reason: The two retrieval arms returned identical comment-ID sets.
A reference that handled a single-argument example failed the reporter's two-argument example; not registered.
A first git apply --check used an unmatched path filter and falsely indicated success; after correction the source patch did not apply and the timezone expectation remained disputed.
The proposed reference coerced BigInt while the discussion included rejecting it with a clearer error.
The discussion did not establish a single accepted behavior for an unknown Content-Type.
Inspection of the pinned source showed array-length allocation already present; no new task registered.

Pre-registration qualification using reduced tolerance variants failed reference accuracy checks and baseline and reference both failed a selected numeric control. The extreme original example was not qualified; no tolerance was relaxed to promote the case.

notes: The qs baseline had one preliminary require in the isolated VM outside the inner network-disabled sandbox; formal recorded qualification ran within it.
Baseline/reference checks for included issues are partial and are detailed in each frozen registration; solution exposure and project overlap remain.
